content.text:
Here's what I found, plus an answer on the SSH prompt.

## The SSH prompt

It wasn't me — every command I ran was a local read (`git status`, `git diff`, `git log` against local refs; no fetch, pull, or push). The likely culprits are the background timers or one of your three other sessions: the `pr-babysit` timer fires every 12 min and the `verify-babysit` timer every 15 min (a `verify-mybd-uiiu-...T182248Z` worktree from today shows the verifier is active), and any of them doing a `git fetch`/`pull` over SSH will pop an askpass GUI if your key's passphrase isn't in the agent. `journalctl --user -u pr-babysit -u verify-babysit --since -20min` would show which one fetched just now.

## What's going on in bd-main

**It's the proxied-dolt lane's leftovers — a stale two-day-old snapshot, not any session's live work.** Three facts explain the ~200 changed files:

1. **HEAD is detached at a May 19 commit** (`a8784aebf`, "release gate PASS for be-llaf"). The reflog shows someone checked it out ~July 23, presumably to reproduce/verify that old release gate.

2. **The index holds a July 24 snapshot of the proxied-dolt work.** The staged tree differs from recent main by ~195 files but from `feat/psxg5-proxy-identity` (the proxied branch, tip dated July 24) by only 38. So all those "new/changed" files — `*_proxied_server.go`, `proxied-local-smoke.yml`, dbproxy internals — are just the proxied work staged over an ancient HEAD, which makes two months of drift *plus* the proxied changes show up as staged modifications. The index hasn't been touched since **July 24, 16:05**.

3. The work continued properly elsewhere: the `psxg5-*` / `fix-5013` worktrees carry the same lane ~5,300 lines further than this snapshot. There are also two unstaged `.githooks/pre-push` and `prepare-commit-msg` edits from the same quarter-hour (July 24, 16:15).

So your instinct was almost right — it doesn't belong to the hotfix or PR-sweep sessions, but it *does* belong to the proxied-dolt lane: an early staging of it, since superseded by the real branches.

**What I'd do (and haven't):** since the proxied session is still running, confirm it isn't deliberately parked on this state before cleaning. If it disowns it, `git -C bd-main checkout main && git pull` restores normality. One thing to check before discarding: the snapshot contains `dolt_clean_databases_purge_test.go` / `..._purge_proxied_integration_test.go` (~250 lines) that the psxg5 branch tip does **not** have — if those purge tests don't live on some other branch, they're unique content worth rescuing first. Per the repo's "notice and report" posture, I've left everything untouched.
